sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (375545)) AND co.condition_start_date >= DATE '2018-01-01');

SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurement m WHERE m.person_id = p.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (3004501)) AND m.value_as_number >= 200);

SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (378419))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procedure_occurrence po WHERE po.person_id = p.person_id AND po.procedure_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (43531648)));

SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM drug_exposure de WHERE de.person_id = p.person_id AND de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (1510813)));
